questions.explanation:
f(x) = sin4x + cos4x

   f'(x) = 4sin3x cosx + 4cos3x ( sinx)

= 4sinx cosx (sin2x cos2x)

= 2sin2x cos2x

= sin4x

As, f(x) is increasing function when f'(x) > 0

    sin4x > 0

   sin4x < 0

    < 4x < 2
